== Description ==
In this video, you'll learn the basics of farming and harvesting.  I will give you tips, tricks and strategies to get your Hay Day game started off right!  Watch the rest of the series! http://goo.gl/16TmKY

Subscribe: http://goo.gl/ZBHn5j

G+: http://goo.gl/dwvYGN

Facebook: http://goo.gl/LyuIN6

Extra Tips:
I recommend you buy farm animals in sets of 3, since you can only make 3 feed bags at a time.  

Remember to SAVE your diamonds.  

Best ways to make money and level up is to bake bread, harvest wheat and make chicken feed.

Other topics in this video include:
  -Town People Requests
  -Bakery and baking
  -How to make money and level up by growing Wheat
  -Why baking bread is good to make money
  -Chicken Fed and making money
